items.label: Market insights, Mg Mg, Purported white-hat hackers withdrew nearly 4,000 bitcoin worth about $320 million from Liquid Network's federation wallet. The withdrawal occurred due to a bug in Blockstream's Elements software that allowed an abnormal peg-out via SideSwap. The parties have communicated on-chain that they will return most of the funds once the bug is fixed and all nodes are patched. Liquid Network has paused operations and exchanges have halted L-BTC deposits and withdrawals. The base Bitcoin network remains unaffected., US spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $986.9 million in net inflows last week, marking the third consecutive week of positive flows. BlackRock's IBIT led with $691.5 million. This follows a strong August with over $3.5 billion in monthly inflows. The data reflects renewed institutional demand even as bitcoin consolidates near $80,000 amid shifting rate expectations and geopolitical developments., AI generated • 14h ago
